messages:
devon: Microprobe nightly flagged a 95th+ tail latency regression for candidate kernel set on H100 (seqlen 2048, kv-cache warm). Can someone sanity-check? FWIW A100 looks fine.

kai: which job? link pls

devon: jobs/microprobe/nightly/2026-12-18 — here's the truncated output:
```
cmd: ./bench_kernels --model=gpt2-xl --seqlen=2048 --kernel=candidate-20261218 --batching=dynamic
95p latency: 42ms -> 71ms (+69%)
median: 12ms -> 13ms
KV cache hit ratio: 0.82
```

anika: hmm kv-cache warm looks lower than expected. Did autotuner pick the longseq path or shortseq fallback?

devon: autotuner chose arch-aware 'fused-gemm-v2' path on H100, fallbacks disabled in nightly. Might be kernel codegen regression.

nikhil: can you run microprobe with `--trace-kv` and `--no-prefetch`? Also send perf counters: l2_miss, sm_efficiency

devon: started rerun: `./bench_kernels ... --trace-kv --no-prefetch --perf=l2_miss,sm_efficiency` — will paste logs

devon: pasted: <https://internal-s3.redwood/perf/logs/1799999000/trace.log>

leah: quick look — L2 miss rate doubles in the longseq path when cache hit ratio dips; looks like index stride changed after recent pack/unpack refactor. cc @eng-runtime

anika: can we gate this in perf CI? add a microbench that exercises kv hot path with seqlen 1024/2048 and assert 95p latency < 60ms on H100

devon: I can add the test. Question: do we run it on nightly only or also in pre-merge for candidate kernels? pre-merge might be noisy but useful for regressions.

nikhil: put it in nightly, and a lightweight smoke in pre-merge (seqlen 512, lower tenure). If smoke fails, flag but don't block deploy; create triage issue.

triage-bot: New perf alert created: PERF-4132 — 'h100-kernel-candidate-longseq-tail' (https://perf.internal/redwood/alerts/PERF-4132)

leah: thanks. devon please open PR with microbench + perf threshold, include perf counters capture

devon: will do this afternoon. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1427

kai: once PR lands, we should add a step in nightly that runs candidate kernels under rt-ci-probe matrix (A100,H100) and upload traces to s3://perf-archive/kv-longseq/1799999000

anika: add note to release playbook to revert fused-gemm-v2 on H100 if PERF-4132 reoccurs after rollout

devon: thanks all, will follow up with PR and the rerun results.
